description: On fresh table-type recordsets over C with Index PK_C (A ASC, B DESC), Seek with each argument shape: = 1, 20; = 1; = (no key); = Missing, 20; = 1, Null; = Null, Null; = Empty, Empty; = "1", "20"; = "abc", 20; = 1.5, 20; = 1, 20, 5; >= 1; > 1; <= 1; < 2; == 1, 20; after each read NoMatch, A and B, MoveNext and read A and B. Then on one recordset Seek "=", 9, 9 (no such key), read NoMatch, BOF, EOF, A; Seek "=", 1, 30, read NoMatch, A, B; MovePrevious and read A, B. Then Seek "=", 1, 20 on a table-type recordset with no Index set and on a dynaset. Asks the omission, Null, coercion and wrong-type policy, recovery after a failed Seek, and the refusal cases. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
